title: Throat of the Hive
description: A high, screaming formant lead built on a sawtooth whose vowel morphs through a-e-i-o-u while a steep pitch envelope flings each note upward like a creature shrieking. Over 16 cycles the FM bite, vibrato depth and band-pass sweep all crawl on prime clocks so the screaming never settles.
code:
setcpm(130/4)
stack(
  note("<c5 [c5 eb5] g5 <bb5 f5>>/2").s("sawtooth")
    .vowel("<a e i o u>/3")
    .penv("<7 12 19 24>/8").pattack(0.001).pdecay(0.12).pcurve(1)
    .fm(sine.slow(16).range(1, 9)).fmh("<1 2 1.5 3>/4")
    .vib("<5 7 11>/8").vibmod(sine.slow(13).range(0.4, 2.6))
    .bpf(saw.slow(24).range(700, 5200)).resonance(19).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(2).lpattack(0.004).lpdecay(0.2)
    .crush("<16 10 7>/16").shape(0.32)
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.12, 0.88))
    .sometimesBy(0.18, x => x.speed(-1))
    .off(1/8, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.28).pan(0.85))
    .delay("0.4:0.375:0.65").room(0.7).gain(0.7)
)
